cases.name: Deleted email provisions a new identity and membership while the original identity, password and membership history stay byte-equivalent
Old sessions, old passwords and old memberships remain revoked; a live pending identity still reserves the email and retries do not create a duplicate
A new invitation activates and authenticates the new account in the requested HN role without inheriting the deleted HCM access
Password recovery selects only the new live identity, never the archived row sharing its email
Locked accounts retain email ownership; Admin-only and organization boundaries remain enforced
Generated login also recreates a fresh identity and a deleted account activation link cannot affect it
Repeated delete and recreate cycles retain every archived identity and still authenticate the single current account
Concurrent requests for the same deleted email produce exactly one current account, including case normalization
MCP provisions and replays the same command, reads both safe history and the new identity, while the current account list excludes the archived one
